welcome_group:
🌳 **Hello! I'm Ari, the Trust Maker assistant.**

I'm here to help your community identify needs, prioritize them, and resolve them with artificial intelligence.

**🧠 What can I do?**
• Record group needs
• Prioritize them with anonymous voting (native Telegram polls)
• Assign the best AIs to solve each need
• Evaluate results and learn from the community

**🗳️ Voting system (anonymous):**
• 👍 *Low* — 1 point — the need is not urgent
• ❤️ *Medium* — 2 points — important, but not critical
• ⭐ *High* — 3 points — urgent, needs immediate attention

Needs with the most points reach the podium and are resolved first.

**💰 Transparent pricing:**
The cost of the tree (group) is split equally among all active members.
The first 2 months are free for new users.
Ask me "how much does it cost?" to see the full breakdown.

**🚀 To get started:**
Send a message mentioning me (@TrustMakerBot) with your need or idea.
Example: *"@TrustMakerBot I need someone to redesign the group logo"*

I'm here to serve you! 🌟
